scope: Native stats_netcdf.F90 lines1350–2293 and corresponding scalar bodies in stats_netcdf_state.cpp plus rank1/rank2 templates in stats_netcdf.hpp. All16 routines in the sampling/cadence/sub-timestep/budget group reviewed. No production edits, compilation or runtime checks by this reviewer.

intermediate budgets: sample-before-lookup order; active-budget requirement; same optional point/profile/surface selections; add-only no counters. Rank2 uniquely stages before active-budget rejection, matching Native source.

final budgets: sample-before-lookup order; l_count_sample defaults true; inactive-budget rejection; closing-state addition; optional counters and oversampling warning; l_budget true/l_in_budget false.
